recommendations.authorRole: Safety and Reliability Engineer, AMIMechE, PhD
recommendations.excerpt: Manoj has impressive technical skills, but equally impressive are his team player skills and his natural attitude to share knowledge
recommendations.quote:
To whom it may concern

It is my pleasure to recommend Manoj Jaya Deep Satya for a position as Data Engineer.

My name is Irene Virdis, a Data Engineer at Expleo group. I started working with the group on March 2022 and that is where I met Manoj.
Manoj and I worked together as Data Engineers in a project for Rolls Royce plc; our main responsibility was the development of tools for predictive maintenance applied to in-service civil aircrafts’ fleets. When I joined the project I had little experience in programming, and Manoj helped me to grow and develop more skills.

Manoj is an incredibly talented developer and data engineer, his knowledge ranges from code and tests development for the back end to User Interface (UI) development. The languages used for the aforementioned project in Rolls Royce were Python, SQL, Spark; the development was following an Agile approach, using Azure DevOps tools, DVSM environment, Office package tools (especially Word, Excel, and Power Point), Databricks, SQL Server Management Studio, Vue.js for the UI, shell scripting. He has been a key team member for the development of testing strategy, being among the first who spontaneously identified the motivations and presented a detailed strategy plan. He is capable to deliver tasks in time and quality when asked, but also to suggest new ideas, strategies, and improvements spontaneously, without being asked.

Manoj has impressive technical skills, but equally impressive are his team player skills and his natural attitude to share knowledge as well as guiding the team with inspiring ideas. He spontaneously organizes meetings with the team to improve the bond and the dialogue among us as well as meetings where he explains us all the new tools he learnt to use and shares suggestions about how to improve our skills. When asked for help, he shows patience and care about the co-workers.

If more information about Manoj’s work is needed, please do not hesitate to contact me via Linked-In message:  https://www.linkedin.com/in/irene-virdis-538411215/

Sincerely,
Irene Virdis
Data Engineer, PhD in Industrial Engineering
